info.name: Player Service
info.description:
Test collection for the Player Service (`services/player-service`).

Run the folders top to bottom (or use the Collection Runner). **Players > Register Player A/B** create two fresh players and store their ids/usernames as collection variables that later requests use; **Cleanup** deletes them.

Variable `baseUrl` defaults to `http://localhost:8080`.

Covers `/api/players`, `/api/players/{player_id}/friends/*`, `/api/players/{player_id}/presence`, `/api/players/{player_id}/inventory/*`, `/api/players/{player_id}/progression-events` and `/api/trades/*`.

item.name: Trades
item.description: Proposing, accepting, declining trades, and the ownership-conflict path. Run after Inventory.

request.description: Setup for the trade tests below - Player B needs something to trade back.
Player A offers itemAId for Player B's itemBId. Stores tradeId.
Player B accepts - ownership is verified and the items swap atomically.

Ownership is re-verified at accept time, not at proposal time - this must fail.
